title: Harness-governed pure-Git pending-branch auto-merge and verified release-candidate promotion
goal: Complete the Susi-native Git-storage integration and release workflow governed by susi-harness and daemon.harness: automatic pending development-branch discovery and 3-way object-store reconciliation into unqualified development main (skipping retired branches, active dirty/claimed worktrees, secret files, and host-created web commits while isolating merge conflicts), strictly separated from distillation-receipt-verified release candidate promotion on local release/<name> and immutable refs/tags/susi-distill/<name> storage snapshots.

results.tests: susi-harness --lib: 527 passed / 0 failed; susi-harness --bins: 41 passed / 0 failed; susi-daemon --lib: 208 passed / 0 failed (5 ignored); xtask --bin susi-dev + --test native_bootstrap: 68 passed / 0 failed; susi --bin susi local_delivery_cli: 34 passed / 0 failed; guard tests (architecture_tests 43, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5, lean_core_ceilings 2, no_github_coupling 5, orphan_sources 3, release_records 5, task_records 3): 66 passed / 0 failed
results.clippy: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi-harness -p susi-daemon -p xtask -p susi --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0

limitations: promote_release_candidate promotes distillation-receipt-verified candidates to local refs/heads/release/<name> and immutable refs/tags/susi-distill/<name> storage snapshots; production vX.Y.Z tags continue to require exact-tree host qualification on both x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.
